name: arxiv-recommender-ar
description: Weekly personalized arXiv paper recommender. Mechanical PREFETCH (SPECTER2 dense + BM25 sparse + citation signal, fused via RRF) feeds Claude as the native reranker; a claim/repo judge gate picks the survivors; the verified-kill ideation loop (arxiv-generate → arxiv-screen → arxiv-verify with EXECUTED probes → arxiv-recheck + refutation hunt) then produces at most one verification-hardened research plan per paper — candidates die on executed evidence, never converge on tier scores. Single entry point: /arxiv-scout-beta; workflows/arxiv-scout.js + workflows/arxiv-ideation.js are the LLM-read specs it enacts.
